definitions.explanation: Used to describe hot weather or ambient temperature. For hot objects or drinks, use 熱い (atsui) with a different kanji.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{暑|あつ}いですね。
{暑|あつ}くて{眠|ねむ}れません。
examples.english: It's so hot I can't sleep.

notes: {暑|あつ}い (with the 'sun' radical {日|ひ}) describes hot weather. Don't confuse with {熱|あつ}い (with the 'fire' radical {灬|れっか}) which describes hot objects or food. Both are pronounced あつい. Conjugation: {暑|あつ}くない (negative), {暑|あつ}かった (past).
